_about: Cost inputs for KoolKisaan Flowers. EVERY price is E (assumption, low / mid / high in rupees) until real quotations arrive. The wax line is calculated: chosen mass x price per kg.

bom.item: Insulated room 8.8 m³ (100 mm PUF panels) + door + strip curtain
Outdoor factory-sealed R290 glycol chiller, inverter, 1.5 kW cooling
Glycol pump + expansion tank + 2 motorised valves + insulated pipes + glycol
Glycol air cooler with EC fan
Cold storage: water / ice with nucleating agent, biocide, leak-tight containers
Aluminium ice panels + fins + glycol coils
1.8 kWp solar PV + mounting + drive electronics
Controls and sensors (incl. R290 gas sensor at the outdoor unit)
Installation and testing (nitrogen + vacuum test, commissioning)
Humidity: ultrasonic fogger + RH controller + small RO filter / RO water can

old_design_refrigeration.item: Old in-room R290 design: condensing unit + in-room evaporator + solenoid/TXV valves + copper pipes

benefit.value_factor_note: E – the Rs value captured by the seasonal twin run depends on the price model; low/high = -30 % / +30 %.
benefit.subsidy_note: E – MIDH cold-chain subsidy: 35 % of the project cost in general areas, 50 % in scheduled / hilly areas. Check the current scheme and its cost norms.

humidity._note: All E. One-time and yearly costs of the humidity options.
